external_input.actual_read_scope: Theorem 1 and complete main proof in Section 2; no full-source or external peer-review certification.
external_input.exact_statement_used: All centered finite jointly real Gaussian vectors, all positive exponents, comparison to product of all marginal moments; with nonzero variances equality iff independence.

theorem_map.range: Every finite collection of arbitrary-size centered jointly real Gaussian blocks, arbitrary PSD joint covariance and all positive real powers.
theorem_map.proof: Positive spherical projection identity, scalar external input, Tonelli, finite Gaussian moments.
theorem_map.equality: Zero block implies equality automatically; otherwise all real cross covariance blocks vanish, equivalently joint independence.

theorem_map.range: Arbitrary finite PSD Gaussian covariance and arbitrary collection of PSD real quadratic forms, with no rank/commutation/support limitation; all positive real powers.
theorem_map.proof: Apply N1 to B_i^(1/2) G; zero trace is equivalent to zero form; covariance Frobenius identity and Gaussian fourth moments.
theorem_map.equality: Automatic if some tr(Sigma B_i)=0; otherwise B_i^(1/2) Sigma B_j^(1/2)=0 for all distinct i,j, equivalent to zero trace(B_i Sigma B_j Sigma) and joint independence of the forms.

theorem_map.range: Every finite centered complex Gaussian block family, proper or improper, all positive real powers.
theorem_map.equality: With no zero block, both Hermitian and pseudo cross covariance vanish; proper jointly Gaussian laws reduce to the Hermitian condition.

theorem_map.range: Positive integer degrees, every trace block and positive real powers.
theorem_map.limitation: No noninteger Gaussian sample representation, determinant product theorem, or arbitrary-grouped product conclusion.

self_checks: Sphere constant positive including S^0 and singular covariance projections.
Nonzero cross covariance has a positive-measure set of nonzero projected covariance; all positive projected variances hold almost everywhere.
Quadratic equality uses Frobenius norm squared, not potentially signed trace inference.
Independent forms force zero covariance; exact Gaussian fourth-moment formula forces full block independence.
Improper complex negative control Z2=conjugate(Z1) has Hermitian cross covariance zero but pseudo cross covariance one, hence strict inequality.
The external scalar GPC was publicly claimed before this note; full Wishart Conjecture1.1 remains unresolved here.
